status: frozen before reprocessing, event-image inspection, temperature-region construction, spectral fitting, or reading a v17 dynamical-feature score
pre_data_correction: Version 1.0.1 lowercases the CIAO enumerated pix_adj value from EDSER to edser after the first invocation rejected the value before creating an output directory or event product; no event image, temperature region, or score had been opened.
pre_cleaning_clarification: Version 1.0.2 freezes a deterministic blank-sky random seed, the source-detection pixel bin, and translation-only Gaia registration before flare/background cleaning or any temperature fit. CIAO's standard matcher offers translation alone or rotation+scale+translation; translation alone preserves the preregistered prohibition on astrometric scale fitting. A commissioning wavdetect catalog for one ObsID had been generated but no event image was visually inspected and no astrometric, cleaning, temperature, or v17 score had been read.
purpose: Construct comparable projected gas-temperature and thermal-stress maps for the spent AS295 and PLCKG287 transfer pair using one detector-reduction and statistical protocol.

runtime.support_caveat: The Chandra X-ray Center documents a WSL installation route but does not formally support WSL as a CIAO platform.

cosmology.name: Planck18
cosmology.reason: Match the already frozen lensing-grid physical scale; cosmology is not fitted in this experiment.

event_reprocessing.bad_pixel_source: observation-specific file regenerated by chandra_repro with CALDB 4.12.4
event_reprocessing.reproducibility: Every command, input hash, output hash, CIAO parameter dump, warning, and exposure is recorded per ObsID.

flare_filtering.source_mask: the first-pass wavdetect regions expanded to 1.5 times their 90-percent-EEF axes
flare_filtering.algorithm: iterative symmetric 3-sigma clipping about the quiescent mean until membership is unchanged
flare_filtering.failure_rule: Fail the ObsID rather than changing its clipping threshold.

astrometry.transform: translation only; no scale, shear, or rotation
astrometry.reference_observation: the ObsID with the greatest cleaned exposure, breaking ties by the lower ObsID
astrometry.failure_rule: Fail the cluster map if any contributing ObsID cannot meet the absolute and relative astrometric gates.

point_sources.mask_radius: 1.5 times the wavdetect 3-sigma ellipse generated with a local 90-percent encircled-energy PSF map
point_sources.hole_filling: Poisson sampling from the immediately surrounding source-free annulus is allowed only for the binning guide image; spectra always exclude source regions.

background.scaling: Retain BKGSCALn and use the corresponding background AREASCAL convention during fitting; never both scale events and scale AREASCAL.
background.robustness_check: Repeat final temperatures with local source-free background where coverage permits; this check cannot select the primary map.

common_map.center: Iterated exposure-corrected diffuse-emission centroid, initialized at the published X-ray center, in a 350-kpc aperture until displacement is below 0.1 pixel.
common_map.guide_image_smoothing: accumulative smoothing to S/N 20 using the scaled blank-sky noise image
common_map.spatial_binning: Sanders 2006 contour binning on the background-subtracted guide image
common_map.failure_rule: Do not change S/N, aperture, exposure cut, or count threshold for one cluster; failure is a failed v17A data gate.

spectral_model.redshift: fixed to the cluster spectroscopic redshift
spectral_model.hydrogen_column: fixed to the HI4PI value queried at the frozen X-ray center
spectral_model.abundance: fit once in the integrated 350-kpc spectrum, then fixed to that measured value in every spatial region of the same cluster
spectral_model.optimizer: levmar followed by neldermead if the first optimization does not converge
spectral_model.uncertainty: 68-percent profile-likelihood interval for temperature with all free regional parameters profiled

temperature_quality_gates.published_validation_rule: The integrated 350-kpc temperature must agree within 20 percent of the published global temperature; this is validation, not calibration.
temperature_quality_gates.minimum_regions_rule: Both clusters must independently retain at least 12 valid regions before a thermal-stress feature is constructed.

thermal_source.kappa_gas: the unchanged registered gas convergence map from the v16B baseline, never an X-ray count proxy
thermal_source.temperature_interpolation: piecewise constant within each contour bin; no smoothing across region boundaries in the primary analysis
thermal_source.uncertainty_propagation: propagate the asymmetric temperature interval and the existing gas-map ensemble independently through every frozen 25, 75, and 150-kpc E-mode triplet
forbidden: using X-ray count brightness as temperature
changing spatial scales after reading a v17 score

map_robustness.resolution_change: repeat the full map construction at 0.492-arcsec pixels
temperature_systematics: primary blank-sky background versus the frozen local-background check
fixed integrated abundance versus abundance free where identifiable

advance_condition: Advance to the spent symmetric cross-cluster transfer only if both clusters pass acquisition, astrometry, background, integrated-temperature, region-count, regional-fit, and map-resolution gates under this unchanged protocol.
claim_boundary: This protocol produces a projected temperature/stress diagnostic, not a three-dimensional pressure tensor.
The clusters and their static comparator maps are spent; no outcome is prospective validation.
Published temperatures are used only to detect a broken reduction, not to tune the map.
A successful transfer would identify useful baryonic source information but would not supply a covariant action or validate Sigma Gravity.
A failure rejects this resolved projected gas-thermal-stress family at the available resolution, not all stress-dependent gravity.
